subject: Implementation Chronicle: MAP & Acceptance Gates (Initial Plan)
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@aurorahealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff & MAP input

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Aurora is excited to move to the onboarding phase. Attached is our internal kickoff note; we wanted your team to propose a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with clear milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria so we can align procurement and implementation dates.

Key constraints on our side:
- Production pilot needs to begin in the week of Feb 8 (constrained by budget cycle)
- On-prem data connectors must be validated before pilot
- Security evidence (SOC2 excerpt + network diagram) required by Jan 20 for our InfoSec review

Can you share a draft MAP this week that maps milestones to Redwood owners and Aurora owners, and flags gated decision points? Also include a short risk list and fallback for capacity or SOC delays.

Thanks — I can host a short 30-min alignment on Friday if useful.

Cheers,
Liam O'Connor
Director of Product, Aurora Health
liam@aurorahealth.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff & MAP input

Hi Liam —

Appreciate the context. Attached is a first-pass "Implementation Chronicle" (MAP-v1.xlsx) that we built to be actionable for procurement and engineering. High-level summary below — please review and call out anything Aurora needs us to change.

High-level milestones (owner in parens, target date):
- InfoSec evidence delivered (Sofia / Security) — 2027-01-15
- Network-connector PoC completed (Ben / Aurora infra) — 2027-01-25
- Pilot provisioning & dry run (Marissa / Aurora ops) — 2027-02-07
- Pilot go/no-go decision (Aurora PM / Sofia) — 2027-02-10
- Production cutover window (joint) — 2027-03-01 to 2027-03-03

Acceptance gates (short):
- Security: SOC2 excerpt + network diagram accepted by Aurora InfoSec
- Functionality: End-to-end generation latency < 400ms p95 on pilot payload
- Data handling: KV-caching and retention config documented; keys in customer KMS verified

Risks & mitigations (brief):
- SOC delay: provide interim SOC2 report + audit contact; offer isolated test environment for verification
- Connector issues: pre-schedule deep-dive with Aurora infra; provide a compatibility checklist and sample configs
- Capacity: can fallback to a quantized variant for pilot to reduce GPU footprint with marginal quality trade-offs

Request: please confirm Aurora owners for the network-connector PoC and the pilot acceptance decision by EOD Friday so we can lock resource bookings.

Attachments: MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet of milestones with dates & owners), Acceptance-Criteria-Checklist.pdf

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@aurorahealth.com>

On Wed, Dec 16, 2026 at 11:04 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com> wrote:
> Attached is a first-pass "Implementation Chronicle" (MAP-v1.xlsx)...

Liam / Sofia — quick notes from infra side:
- We can run the connector PoC the week of Jan 18 if Aurora confirms the infra point-of-contact. Requesting the hostnames and an SSH lab account by Jan 10.
- I'll own the connector template and test harness (Ben Carter). Deliverable: connector-test-report.xlsx by 2027-01-25.
- For the latency acceptance gate, I'll provision a benchmark container and share the test script. If p95 > 400ms we will iterate with quantization knobs but aim to keep quality ~95% of full-fp run.

Action items for Aurora (please assign):
1) Name infra owner to coordinate PoC (due: 2027-01-10)
2) Confirm pilot user list for traffic shaping tests (due: 2027-01-20)

I'll update MAP-v1 with the test-harness workstream and link the connector template.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
Attachment: Procurement-Checklist.docx (procurement asks for reserved capacity and SOW terms)

Thanks — this looks good and actionable. Confirming Aurora owners:
- Infra lead: Priya Menon <priya.menon@aurorahealth.com> (will send explicit calendar invites)
- Pilot PM: Grace Hall <grace.hall@aurorahealth.com>

We accept the proposed dates with one ask: can Redwood commit to the InfoSec bundle delivery by Jan 15? Our procurement team needs that before the budget sign-off on Jan 20. If yes, we can target the pilot provisioning week of Feb 7 as proposed.

Also, please upload the finalized MAP-v1 to the Drive link and add a short section in the spreadsheet for procurement dependencies (licenses, reserved capacity, billing contact). I'll route the procurement doc to our legal once you confirm the procurement checklist items.

If we get the InfoSec pack on Jan 15, Aurora will target the go/no-go call on Feb 10 and the first pilot run the week of Feb 14.

Thanks — scheduling the 30-min alignment for Friday (invite incoming).

— Liam
